subject.title: fix: reject malformed gateway websocket requests [AI]

question: Should the gateway permanently reject all HTTP-path requests with an `Upgrade` header after confirming that no supported non-WebSocket upgrade flow relies on this path?
rationale: This is intentional protocol-boundary behavior rather than a purely mechanical correction, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision after compatibility review.

options.title: Adopt after protocol proof
options.body: Confirm the supported gateway upgrade protocols and accept the narrow `400` behavior with real gateway output for malformed and valid requests.

options.title: Narrow the rejection rule
options.body: Keep prior behavior for any supported non-WebSocket upgrade flow and reject only the malformed claim shapes that are proven to hang.

recommendation.title: Adopt after protocol proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the supported gateway upgrade protocols and accept the narrow `400` behavior with real gateway output for malformed and valid requests.
